component.name: QualCoder
component.summary: The free, open source desktop software for qualitative data analysis

description.p: QualCoder can code text, images, audio and video, write journal notes and memos. You can organise codes in a tree-like categorisation scheme. Various reports can be generated. Most reports can be exported as html, open document text (ODT), plain text or Excel files.
QualCoder 4.0 adds hierarchical sub-codes, restructures AI features into an agent with tiered access, and reorganizes menus with a new Analysis menu.

ul.li: AI agent can search code trees, memos, codings, and data. Access modes: read-only, sandboxed write, and full write with confirmation for destructive actions.
Sub-codes allow code hierarchies in addition to category hierarchies.
Core languages: English, German, French, Spanish. Additional languages are in the Other Languages folder and may not be human-reviewed or recently updated.
New Analysis menu; Manage, Coding, and Reports tabs now include explanatory placeholder information.
Journals: ODT export, convert journal to a project file for coding, open URLs, and insert timestamps, coded text, and references.
Manage files: import surveys from Excel/CSV, import PDF highlights with automatic coding by highlight colour, and import LaTeX as plain text.
Coding screens: code-tree Modify/Filter/Sort submenus, code-name filter, move-category function, resizable columns, and improved tree navigation.
Code text: font/size selection, resizable codes, underline/vertical-stripe highlighting, ODF export, bookmark shortcuts, and search in edit mode.
Code PDF: improved PDF display/manipulation, text and image-area coding, AI-assisted text analysis, PDF highlight export, ODT reports, and legacy project refactoring.
A/V coding: bookmarks, restored time/text positions, and VLC or Qt Media Player support. Image coding areas can be resized.
